summary: Charles Schwab filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $3.0bn three-tranche senior notes offering: $300M floating-rate notes due 2030 at compounded SOFR plus 0.890%, $1.3bn 5.334% fixed-to-floating notes due 2030 (resetting November 2029 to SOFR plus 0.890%), and $1.4bn 5.732% fixed-to-floating notes due 2034 (resetting November 2033 to SOFR plus 1.280%). All priced at par, with a 0.250% underwriting discount; notes are senior unsecured, redeemable at the issuer's option, unlisted, and rank pari passu with existing senior debt. This is an ordinary investment-grade debt capital raise, not a special situation.
